prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square transparent mineral-overlay master for a Minecraft Java 16x16 ore block.
Primary request: Brassroot FRAGMENT independent variant 2: A low-angle sphalerite-filled bedding opening meets a 2-cell steep joint stub near one end; the honey-brown aggregate is discontinuous but physically related. Geological identity: carbonate-hosted gray-honey sphalerite joint fill and bedding replacement. This is an incidental partial window into the deposit, not a complete diagram on one block. Its dip, thickness pattern, interruption and structure must differ materially from retained variant 0 and sibling variant 1; never a rotation, mirror, recolor or relocated stamp.
Scene/backdrop: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside physical mineral cells; no host stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard, panel or shadow.
Style/medium: coarse logical 16x16 pixel art authored at high resolution, with hard-edged square pixel clusters about one-sixteenth of the canvas width. Flat mostly opaque medium values; no subpixel marks, hairlines, antialiasing or smooth miniature painting.
Composition/framing: FRAGMENT: about 12–26 visible logical cells, one incomplete trace 2 cells thick and 4–7 cells long, at least 10 visible and 6 connected. No forced edge contact or full-width band. Shape coherence and role hierarchy matter more than exact numeric fill. Keep most of the square transparent. The whole family identity emerges across varied tiled blocks; this single block shows only the local section described.
Materials/textures: muted gray-honey brown sphalerite and carbonate gray, at most a rare dull brass grain; no gold outline. Use two or three close mineral values grouped inside structures, enough to read at native16 against mid-gray host. No dark outline, pale highlight rail, extreme pigment, halo, carved or raised relief, or blanket alpha fade.
Constraints: exactly one 1:1 square PNG at least 1024x1024, untouched mineral-only source with true transparent alpha, one standalone texture, no text, label, watermark or frame.
Avoid: literal root/tree icon, central trunk, bright yellow rail, branching web; decorative speckles, centered object, complete whole-face seam or network, glow, gradients, haze, vignette, realism.
